results.description: The merchant swaps the settlement payee to an attacker address after the human signed the predicate.
steps: Human signs a predicate restricted to the approved merchant.
Merchant substitutes the settlement payee with an attacker address.
Predicate guard evaluates the concrete settlement BEFORE any transfer.

results.description: A revoked merchant identity is presented alongside an unapproved payee; the guard rejects on the payee.
steps: Merchant identity is revoked but its content is still served.
Attacker routes payment to a fresh address.
Predicate guard rejects the payee before settlement.

results.description: A compromised agent (application logic, not the signing key) raises the settlement amount above the human cap.
steps: Human signs a predicate capping spend at 5.00.
Compromised agent orchestration submits 9.99.
Predicate guard rejects the over-limit settlement before any transfer.

results.description: A compromised agent settles in an asset the human never allowed.
steps: Human allows USDC only.
Compromised agent submits a WETH settlement.
Predicate guard rejects the asset before any transfer.

results.description: A compromised agent moves settlement to a chain outside the predicate.
steps: Human allows chain 84532 only.
Compromised agent targets chain 1.
Predicate guard rejects the chain before any transfer.

results.description: A compromised agent settles a different task than the one the human authorized.
steps: Human pins task hash eeee… to the predicate.
Compromised agent delivers a settlement for task aaaa….
Predicate guard rejects the task mismatch before any transfer.

results.description: The agent attempts to settle after the human's authorization window closed.
steps: Human authorized spending until 04:00Z.
Agent attempts settlement at 05:05Z.
Predicate guard rejects the expired authorization before any transfer.

results.description: Step 1: discovery is prompt-injected to select an unapproved merchant. Step 2: the settlement payee follows the injected selection.
steps: Attacker injects a merchant recommendation into untrusted merchant content.
Agent selection follows the injected payee.
Settlement is built for the injected payee.
Predicate guard rejects at the payee rule before any transfer.

results.description: Step 1: the agent settles a legitimate payment. Step 2: it replays the same signed payload to double-settle.
steps: Agent settles the legitimate 2.00 payment (nonce consumed).
Agent replays the identical signed payload.
Facilitator rejects the second settlement on the consumed nonce.
notes: Replay rejected by the facilitator on the consumed nonce.
